slices.title: Make CI run where work lands
slices.summary: Puts the integration branch into the branch filters of buf.yml, verevonv3-ci.yml and quarry-v2-ci.yml on both triggers (K1-23 list, with develop), applies the same filter change to verevonv3-security.yml, adds the CI baseline doc with an owner per pre-existing red, and creates the repo-gates.yml trigger shell so CI runs where work lands.
slices.needs_external: DEC-39 D1(c): changing the GitHub default branch from dev is an owner repo setting; request it from the repo owner

slices.title: Repair buf gate
slices.summary: Quotes the paths with spaces in the buf workflow, regenerates the 0-byte baseline image from the committed protos, adds a lint ratchet keyed on a committed per-finding baseline, and adds a CI self-proof that buf breaking fails on a deleted field.

slices.title: Fix named language leaks
slices.summary: Replaces the hard-coded Norwegian and English-only labels in the chat approval block, plan-grant rungs, artifact tabs and cards, live-run status words and fleet console with i18n.tr calls, using a rungLabel helper for the three grant rungs and renaming the fleet pause control to Cancel fleet (D6).
test_commands: cd "apps/Frontend Plane/verevonv3" && pnpm exec vitest run src/features/chat/components/ChatMessages.approval-locale.test.tsx src/features/chat/components/ChatArtifactPanel.test.tsx src/features/chat/components/ChatPanels.test.tsx src/features/agents/components/FleetRunConsole.test.tsx

slices.title: UI copy and raw-colour gate with baseline
slices.summary: Adds an ESLint UI-gates config with selectors for bare copy, naming attributes and raw colours in chat and agents, a suppression baseline, a scan of newly added src files, and a separate spa-ui-gates CI job so new leaks in those scopes fail CI.
slices.needs_external: DEC-39 (D1 CI branch policy, D2 gate ownership): the spa-ui-gates job cannot block before it; rollout is ESLint warn for three runs, then error

slices.title: English-locale leak smoke and state checklist
slices.summary: Adds a locale-leak helper and a smoke test that renders the approval, plan-control, artifact, live-run and run-proof components under en and no and fails on Norwegian text, plus a UI state checklist doc and an updated criterion 9 in the chat design doc.

slices.title: Taxonomy gate covers second emitter family
slices.summary: Extends the SSE taxonomy generator to cover ad-hoc producer event names and the orchestration oneof, restricts the SPA case scan to the native dispatchEvent switch, regenerates the taxonomy doc, and adds orchestration.proto to the sse-taxonomy workflow paths.

slices.title: Rust-generated SSE payload golden
slices.summary: Adds a payload_contract test module in model-gateway that samples every ChatEvent variant and writes a key, type and presence golden, with a sha256 pair, a vendored SPA copy, sync-script rows, an LF rule for contract JSON, and a frame verifier script.
slices.needs_external: WS01-S0 staging stack with a model provider route and the ZDR-TEST org, with operator access, for the live chat turn and the ZDR turn
test_commands: cd "apps/Model Plane/rust" && cargo test -q -p model-gateway --lib payload_contract

slices.title: SPA read checker and generated types
slices.summary: Generates SPA TypeScript types for the chat event payloads from the S7 golden and adds a contract test that checks every field the SPA reads in dispatchEvent cases and emit helpers against it, moving the emitCitation and usage paths onto the generated type.
slices.needs_external: WS01-S0 staging stack, with operator access, to re-run the S7 live transcript against the final SPA

slices.title: Plane-boundary gate
slices.summary: Adds a repo-root gate that requires plane-local database hosts in compose files and env examples, bans cross-plane database links in source, and allows only the documented Quarry SDK path dependency, with fixtures and a self-test.
slices.needs_external: DEC-39 D2 gate ownership (matrix row, CODEOWNERS, one named maintainer) before the gate can block merges

slices.title: Log-content gate
slices.summary: Adds a repo-root gate that flags log macros in the four Model Plane Rust services when they interpolate prompt, completion, transcript, message or body values, with an allow comment, a reviewed hash baseline and a self-test.
slices.needs_external: DEC-39 D2 gate ownership before the gate can block merges

slices.title: File size ratchet
slices.summary: Adds a repo-root ratchet that caps hand-written source files at 3,000 lines using per-file ceilings in a committed baseline that may only shrink, compares against the base ref so a PR cannot relax it, and adds an optional, off-by-default clippy count ratchet to the Model Plane Rust CI.
slices.needs_external: DEC-39 D2 gate ownership before the gate can block merges

slices.title: Stack-free browser-fixture job and bundle budget
slices.summary: Adds a verevonv3 CI job that runs the chunk-recovery Playwright project against a stack-free build, and a shrink-only gzipped bundle budget checked after the SPA verify step, with its own node test.
slices.needs_external: DEC-39 D1 CI branch policy before the job can block; the job skips until the WS09 S5 chunk-recovery project exists
